findings.evidence: `prod_map_factorial_indiscrete` itself splits on `n = 0`, and only rewrites with `Nat.Partition.indiscrete_parts hn.ne'` in the positive case, confirming that the claimed single-part description is not valid uniformly.
findings.fix: Qualify the one-part/single-block descriptions with `n > 0`, or consistently call this the indiscrete/coarsest partition and describe the zero case accurately.
findings.issue: The module text and docstrings at lines 16, 64, and 83 call `indiscrete n` one-part or say it has the single part `n`; the same inaccurate wording appears in `YoungSubgroup.lean` lines 218–219 and throughout `PermutationModule/Extremes.lean` (lines 12–18, 49, 51–52, 78, and 85). For `n = 0`, `indiscrete 0` has no parts or blocks.

summary: Documentation repeatedly describes `Nat.Partition.indiscrete n` as having one part or one block, which is false at `n = 0`.
